document.subtitle: The works plan for Meridian technology

paragraphs: You have asked great questions: Do you have your CONOPS? Where is the RACI? When will my plant get an architect? This guide answers them in one place, and it is yours to keep.

paragraphs.lead: One target state. Every plant aligned.
paragraphs.text: Technology Strategy & Architecture exists for four outcomes: invest in what matters, deliver faster, simplify the estate, and take risk on purpose. Every standard, roadmap and review in this guide traces back to one of them.

paragraphs: I wrote this guide as a works plan, because that is how the work runs. TS&A draws the plant layout and sets the tolerances. Plants and product teams design and build within them. The ARB is the inspection gate for the work that shapes the whole line. A works runs when everyone builds to the same plan.
